reading: The sketch lays out a Users admin page: a "Users" heading, an indigo "+ Invite user" button top-right, a toolbar with a search input and two filter dropdowns, a data table with named columns, 7 rows, and colored status pills, and a zigzag decorative divider at the bottom.

actions.instruction: Add a page heading with the text 'Users'.
Add a pill-shaped button with indigo background and white text reading '+ Invite user', placed at the top right near the 'Users' heading.
Add a toolbar row below the heading containing a search input with placeholder 'Search by name or email…', and two dropdown filters labeled 'Role: All' and 'Sta
Add a data table below the toolbar with columns 'NAME', 'EMAIL', 'ROLE', 'STATUS', 'LAST SEEN' and 7 rows of sample user data. Render the STATUS column as color
Add a decorative zigzag divider line spanning the full width at the bottom of the table, matching the drawn jagged wave shape exactly.
